incoming.name: Nuclear power
incoming.excerpt: Fission produces gases such as iodine-131 or Xenon-133 which have to be stored on-site for several half-lives until they have decayed to safe levels.

outgoing.name: Earth's atmosphere
outgoing.excerpt: Xenon is a trace gas in Earth's atmosphere, occurring in one part in twenty million.
